title_as_printed: Summary of individual run data for CH4

footnotes_as_printed.a: The values for temperature and pressure define the intersection of lines AB and BC in figure 2.
footnotes_as_printed.b: A_S is the calculated value for the Setschenow constant for each run.

pressure_note: total pressure at the intersection of the liquid-vapour (two-phase) and one-phase liquid P-T curves of a fixed-volume, fixed-composition run, i.e. the saturation (bubble-point) pressure at that T; includes water vapour pressure

value.note: overall methane molality of the loaded charge (moles CH4 per kg water); equals the solubility at the intersection point

composition.note: wt% NaCl in the brine charge (salt-free CH4 basis); 0 = pure water

extra_unmapped: A_S (calculated Setschenow constant per run, derived by authors; '-' for pure water)
conversion_needs: wt% NaCl to molality NaCl: m = 1000*w/(58.443*(100-w))
notes: Each row is a bubble point at fixed volume and composition (not an isotherm). Replicate charges share the same molality. Table has 30 runs; the text states Setschenow constant 0.129 +- 0.030.
